name: Total Madness increases damage taken by its tooltip percentage (#5701)
contract: Total Madness 803061 effect 0 is native aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, MiscValue 127 (all schools), BasePoints 29 / DieSides 1, i.e. +30%; its tooltip reads 'You take $s1% increased damage.' AscensionCultistContracts.cpp only zeroes effect 1 (a periodic trigger) for this spell id, leaving effect 0 untouched. SpellAuraEffects.cpp:152 routes aura 87 through Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken/MeleeDamageBonusTaken, both native. spell_damage_taken queries Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken with a fixed base of 1000 and `target` as the attacker, submitting no attack, so the comparison is unaffected by hit/crit/mitigation variance. The baseline is taken before Insanity reaches 100 because Total Madness cannot be present yet.
